data.name: Deepashri
data.long_meaning: Deepa (light) + Ashri (knowledge or wisdom). This name signifies the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom. The divine goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, is often depicted holding a lamp (Deepa) in her hand. Hence, Deepashri is a name that evokes the goddess's blessings.
